note: Mercantil Banco Universal: its interest rates page (rates in force from 15 September 2026, read rendered) gives credit cards not indexed to the UVC at a maximum of 60% a year, written as the rate (the bank says an operation's rate may differ within its minimum and maximum); its schedule of fees and commissions (in force from 18 September 2026, set within the Banco Central de Venezuela's ceilings) gives the most it charges to issue a holder's card, 3,314 bolívars at each of the four card levels, a cash advance fee of up to 5% of the sum (written as 5%), and 560 bolívars for a cheque drawn on another bank returned unpaid when paying the card. The schedule names no fee to hold a card, so none is written. The UVC-indexed cards (16% a year over the index) aren't written; the late-payment surcharge of up to 3% a year on non-UVC credit is charged on the overdue amount on top of the interest, not one of the form's terms, and isn't written. Replacement fees aren't written; no minimum payment, grace period or foreign transaction fee is published. Wave 4 (30 October 2026) looked for more banks and added none: Banco de Venezuela's rate report for September 2026 gives its card rate as 'up to 60%' with no period stated, so it isn't written (its tariff of September 2026 gives a 3,314-bolívar issue charge and a cash advance of up to 5%); Banesco's and BBVA Provincial's sites refused the request (403). No minimum payment is published for Mercantil Banco Universal's card; tried (wave 5, 30 October 2026): every document this file cites, downloaded again on 30 October 2026 and searched for a minimum payment, states none for them; no web search was made for them in this wave, the searches shared by every agent having gone to the larger countries; archive.org's availability API names no snapshot of the 2 documents this file cites.
